scope: Current public source packages; external deployment assets require a separate controlled inventory.

meaning.mapped_query: A declared query-to-action mapping passes package/schema validation; per-command execution evidence is still required.
meaning.write_command: A possible action target or standalone write; being a write does not prove that every query has its needed follow-up.
meaning.declared_no_actions: The author explicitly declared no actions; this alone does not certify that no follow-up is needed.
meaning.pending_source_review: Implementation review remains; do not classify this as terminal, unnecessary, or externally blocked.

commands.name: 12306.cn.price
noActionReasons: Seat prices are terminal values; this package has no booking or seat-specific detail command. Booking is an unsupported capability, not a missing identifier mapping.

commands.name: 12306.cn.passengers
noActionReasons: Saved passenger records have no per-passenger detail, edit, delete or booking command in this package. Do not persist masked identity fields as executable identifiers.

commands.name: 12306.cn.orders
noActionReasons: Order summaries have no order-detail, cancel or payment command in this package; train_code is a public service code and cannot substitute for internal train_no. These follow-ups require new Adapter capabilities.

commands.name: 1688.com.whoami
noActionReasons: Returns authenticated account identity only. There is no account-detail, purchase-history or account-edit command; public product search is an independent query.

commands.name: 1688.com.download
noActionReasons: Returns media URLs and suggested filenames only. No command in this package saves a media file or opens an individual media asset; download-to-disk requires a separate capability.

commands.name: 1688.com.store
noActionReasons: Returns supplier profile and contact fields. This package has no shop-scoped product listing or contact-seller operation; keyword search cannot represent shop inventory.

commands.name: 36kr.com.article
noActionReasons: Article fields include an explicitly capped body; there is no full-text, author-profile or comment command. Opening the returned URL is an Agent/browser handoff, not an invented Adapter action.

commands.name: bilibili.com.check-login-status
noActionReasons: Login diagnostic only; this package has no user profile, account settings or account-history command.

commands.name: bilibili.com.read-comments
noActionReasons: Comment summaries have no stable comment IDs and this package has no comment-detail, reply or author-profile command. These require new Adapter capabilities.

commands.name: ctrip.com.whoami
noActionReasons: Account diagnostic only; no profile-detail, order-history or account-edit command exists.

commands.name: ctrip.com.hotel
noActionReasons: Hotel profile is terminal in this package; no room-list, room-detail, reservation or payment command exists.

commands.name: ctrip.com.train
noActionReasons: Train service candidates have no train-detail, fare-detail or booking command in this package. Public train numbers are not 12306 internal train_no identifiers.

commands.name: ctrip.com.bus
noActionReasons: Bus candidates have no departure-detail, seat selection or booking command in this package.

commands.name: ctrip.com.ferry
noActionReasons: Ferry candidates have no sailing-detail, cabin selection or booking command in this package.

commands.name: ctrip.com.flight
noActionReasons: Flight candidates have no itinerary-detail, seat selection or booking command in this package; flight-round is a separate route/date query, not detail for this row.

commands.name: ctrip.com.flight-round
noActionReasons: Round-trip combinations have no combination-detail, seat selection or booking command in this package; a one-way search would discard the selected combination and quote scope.

commands.name: ctrip.com.attraction
noActionReasons: Attraction candidates have no sight-detail, review or ticket command in this package.

commands.name: ctrip.com.cruise
noActionReasons: Cruise candidates have no route-detail, cabin-detail or booking command in this package.

commands.name: ctrip.com.tour
noActionReasons: Tour product candidates have no product-detail or booking command in this package. A keyword query cannot represent the selected product.

commands.name: ctrip.com.package
noActionReasons: Package candidates have no product-detail or booking command in this package. Another keyword query cannot verify this exact package price or inclusions.

commands.name: dianping.com.shop
noActionReasons: Shop profile fields have no per-review, menu, reservation or purchase command in this package; these require additional Adapter capabilities.

commands.name: dianping.com.whoami
noActionReasons: Account diagnostic only; there is no member-profile or account-settings command. Shop search is a separate query.

commands.name: douban.com.subject
noActionReasons: Book detail is terminal: no book reviews, purchase or author-detail command; movie photos cannot receive a book ID.

commands.name: douban.com.search
noActionReasons: Music search has no music subject-detail or music playback command. Movie/book detail must not receive music IDs.

commands.name: douyin.com.drafts
noActionReasons: Draft rows identify unpublished drafts. No draft-detail, edit, publish or draft-delete command exists; the published-work delete and stats commands must not be used for draft IDs.

commands.name: douyin.com.collections
noActionReasons: Creator mix metadata is returned. No collection-items, collection-detail or collection-edit command accepts mix_id; video IDs must not be substituted for mix IDs.

commands.name: douyin.com.activities
noActionReasons: Activity metadata is returned. No activity-detail or enrollment command accepts activity_id; participation is an unavailable downstream capability.

commands.name: douyin.com.location
noActionReasons: POI suggestions are returned. No POI-detail, map or publish-with-location command accepts poi_id; coordinates or video identities cannot be invented.

commands.name: douyin.com.stats
noActionReasons: The selected owned work metrics are already returned in full. No per-metric detail command exists; a metric name is not an aweme_id.

commands.name: douyin.com.user-videos
noActionReasons: Public user videos and optional top comments are returned. No public video-detail, selected-video comments or download command exists; owned-work stats/update/delete cannot be applied to another user videos.

commands.name: douyin.com.search
noActionReasons: Public video cards contain video URLs and display names only. No public video-detail or selected-video comments command exists, and author names are not sec_uid. Creator stats/update/delete are not valid public-card follow-ups.

commands.name: gitee.com.user
noActionReasons: Profile metrics are terminal in this package; there is no username-scoped repository list, follower list or account-edit command. Keyword repository search is not an owner-scoped list.

commands.name: github.com.check-login-status
noActionReasons: Diagnostic login state; no per-account detail or settings command exists. Repository search is a separate user query.

commands.name: goofish.com.get-login-qrcode
noActionReasons: Host login diagnostic only; not a selectable business entity.

commands.name: goofish.com.whoami
noActionReasons: Account diagnostic; no own-item inventory, account-profile or account-settings command. Inbox is a separate query.

commands.name: jd.com.check-login-status
noActionReasons: Host login/navigation diagnostic only; not a selectable business result.

commands.name: jd.com.get-login-qrcode
noActionReasons: Host login/navigation diagnostic only; not a selectable business result.

commands.name: jd.com.navigate-to-homepage
noActionReasons: Host login/navigation diagnostic only; not a selectable business result.

commands.name: jd.com.view-orders
noActionReasons: Order records are terminal: no order-detail, cancellation or selected-order payment command. Product details are nested and must not be guessed from an order ID.

commands.name: juejin.cn.check-login-status
noActionReasons: Diagnostic login state; it is not a content object and has no account-detail command.

commands.name: juejin.cn.list-detail-candidates
noActionReasons: The current source is an inspect_only stub returning empty candidate arrays unconditionally. Candidate discovery and content reading need implementation; do not claim that actual content has no follow-up actions.

commands.name: mail.163.com.get-login-qrcode

commands.name: mail.163.com.navigate-to-inbox

commands.name: mail.163.com.get-current-page-info

commands.name: mail.google.com.check-login-status
noActionReasons: 只返回登录检测结果，不含可可靠绑定的账户身份；不把检测状态当作邮件。

commands.name: mail.google.com.navigate-to-inbox
noActionReasons: 导航回执，不返回邮件对象；需独立调用未读或搜索查询获取邮件列表。

commands.name: mail.google.com.get-current-page-info

commands.name: mail.qq.com.check-login-status
noActionReasons: 只返回登录检测结果，不含可可靠绑定的账户身份；不把检测状态当作邮件。

commands.name: mail.qq.com.navigate-to-inbox
noActionReasons: 导航回执，不返回邮件对象；需独立调用未读或搜索查询获取邮件列表。

commands.name: mail.qq.com.get-current-page-info
noActionReasons: 页面状态诊断，不返回邮件ID或附件列表；不按页面标题猜邮件，也不把可能带会话参数的页面URL保存为对象身份。

commands.name: news.ycombinator.com.user
noActionReasons: 当前命令只返回用户资料（username/karma/created/about）；现有包不提供按用户列帖子、用户详情下钻或用户写操作。

commands.name: note.youdao.com.note
noActionReasons: Returns public shared-note text, summary and keywords. This package has no per-block, attachment, edit or delete operation; share URL resolution remains part of this read.

commands.name: smzdm.com.search
noActionReasons: This package contains only search. Result links cannot become detail, comment, purchase or save actions until those Adapter commands exist.

commands.name: tieba.baidu.com.read

commands.name: toutiao.com.hot
noActionReasons: Public headline candidates have no article-detail command in this package. Creator articles is the signed-in account management list, not a public article reader.

commands.name: toutiao.com.recommend
noActionReasons: Public feed candidates have no article-detail command in this package. Do not route their group IDs into the unrelated creator management list.

commands.name: toutiao.com.articles
noActionReasons: Creator rows contain title/date/metrics but no stable article ID or detail/edit/publish command. Both source identity extraction and target capabilities would be required for per-article actions.

commands.name: weread.qq.com.ai-outline
noActionReasons: 返回大纲正文或结构化大纲行；当前包没有章节正文读取或大纲节点操作命令。

commands.name: weread.qq.com.book-search

commands.name: weread.qq.com.highlights

commands.name: weread.qq.com.notes

commands.name: wikipedia.org.page
noActionReasons: Plain-text article extract is terminal in this package; no section, linked-page list, category or edit command exists. Re-reading with another paragraph limit is a new explicit query, not an object action.

commands.name: xiaohongshu.com.creator-profile

commands.name: xiaohongshu.com.creator-stats

commands.name: xiaohongshu.com.navigate-to-homepage

commands.name: xueqiu.com.comments

commands.name: xueqiu.com.earnings-date
noActionReasons: 返回财报发布日期和状态，当前包没有财报正文或按财报事件下钻的命令。

commands.name: xueqiu.com.feed
noActionReasons: Post discussion results; no post-detail, author-profile or reply/like command. Stock quote commands are not valid targets for post IDs.

commands.name: xueqiu.com.fund-holdings

commands.name: xueqiu.com.fund-snapshot

commands.name: xueqiu.com.hot

commands.name: xueqiu.com.kline

commands.name: zhihu.com.pins
noActionReasons: No individual pin-detail, pin-reply or pin-like command. Answer/article operations must not receive a pin ID.

commands.name: zhipin.com.chatmsg
noActionReasons: Read history may resolve either identity side; send supports recruiters only. Requery with side=boss before preparing a recruiter reply.
No job-seeker send or individual message-detail command; recruiter send must not receive a job-seeker conversation UID.

commands.name: zhipin.com.detail

commands.name: zhipin.com.whoami
noActionReasons: Local-cookie login diagnostic, not verified account identity; do not bind account actions.
